name: AUC-ROC of Cross-validated Random Forest consensus classifier (top-221 features)
description: Assessment dataset: AUC-ROC of Cross-validated Random Forest consensus classifier (top-221 features) on 1642 scored entries (entry_id corrected to ID_InterfaceID for ProtCID-derived complexes -- the original bare-ID matching silently dropped ~700 ProtCID entries). Recomputed value 0.9474 vs. published 0.94.
